sourceSentences: Poppy dashes to the target enemy's location. If they are in range upon arrival, she deals physical damage and carries them along with her for up to 400 units.
If the target hits terrain, she stops to deal the same physical damage again and stuns them for a duration.
Poppy will be ordered to basic attack the target.
Heroic Charge can interact with player-generated terrain.
The dash does not follow targets. The target's position at the time of Heroic Charge's cast is the direction Poppy will dash towards.
Steadfast Presence does not stop dashes if the unit is crowd control immune, displacement immune, untargetable, or protected by spell shield in the process
Steadfast Presence does not trigger against lunges.
Poppy increases her total armor and total magic resistance by 16%, doubled to 32% while she is below 40% maximum health.
Poppy can move over the buckler to retrieve it, gaining a shield for 3 seconds. Enemy champions can move over the buckler to destroy it.
If Keeper's Verdict was charged for at least 0.5 seconds, it deals 100% increased damage and enemies hit are knocked back toward the enemy team's fountain
If the charge is interrupted or completes without reactivation, Keeper's Verdict is cancelled and the ability is put on a 30-second cooldown.
Additionally, if no enemies are hit in front of Poppy, she sends a shockwave that travels in the target direction until it collides with an enemy champion, which causes a hammer to erupt.
Keeper's Verdict's airborne debuff is non-dispellable and thus cannot be removed by cleansing effects.
The impact creates a field for 1 second that slows enemies within, which then ruptures to deal the same physical damage.
For combos, your go-to is to W if needed, then E them into terrain. From here, attack into Q before attacking away.
and a good go-to if you can't stand them into terrain is a W if needed into your E. From here, attack into Q and tap your ultimate to keep them in the second part of the queue before attacking away.
Poppy's W has a passive where she gains bonus armor and magic resist, and when below 40% health, she gains double the amount.
If tapped, it deals damage to enemies in front of her and briefly knocks them up. However, it can also be charged, slowing herself.
